title: auricula-ursi glaucescens
intro: Auricula-ursi glaucescens, commonly known as Bearberry, is a flowering plant belonging to the heath family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial and antiviral properties, which have been used to treat urinary tract infections and diarrhea. The therapeutic actions of Bearberry include its ability to reduce inflammation and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Bearberry include arbutin, which has been shown to exhibit antimicrobial activity, as well as other compounds such as phenolic acids and flavonoids.
